constraints: SI-4 (canonical, fixed contract): signature is summarize_spend(self, *, since: datetime | None = None, until: datetime | None = None) -> SpendSummary. SpendSummary is a frozen dataclass with fields input_tokens, output_tokens, cache_creation_tokens, cache_read_tokens (each int, names mirroring the attempts columns) plus total_cost_usd: float. Do not rename these fields or change the keyword-only window shape -- downstream spec 00032 implements this verbatim on Postgres.

The window is half-open [since, until) measured against attempts.last_activity_at; an attempt with NULL last_activity_at contributes to the unbounded total but is excluded from any bounded window; the identical predicate runs on every backend so all three return the same totals for the same data.
SI-9: add NO column, NO index, and do NOT bump CURRENT_SCHEMA_VERSION (stays 12). summarize_spend reads only existing v12 attempts columns.

Keep flywheel_core.task and flywheel_core.lifecycle pure: SpendSummary and the method live on the store protocol + concrete stores, never in task/lifecycle. The store_protocols module must stay import-pure (no json/pathlib/io/sqlite) -- SpendSummary is a plain frozen dataclass over datetime/int/float.
Per-run rollups (flywheel history / run-detail token and cost totals) must remain byte-for-byte unchanged: do not edit _attempt_rollups or collect_live_rows in this task.

edge_cases: Empty store: summarize_spend with and without a window returns all-zero totals (0 tokens, 0.0 cost), never None and never a raise.
Window containing no attempts returns all-zero totals, NOT the grand total -- a total-ignoring implementation that returns the all-time sum must fail this.
Half-open boundary: an attempt exactly at `until` is excluded; an attempt exactly at `since` is included.
Multiple runs: the returned total is the sum across ALL runs' attempts, not the latest run and not a single run -- chosen seeds make no single run equal the grand total.
A returned constant or a single-run sum must fail the held-out assertion, which compares against a computed multi-run sum.
